scripts.usage: wrangler d1 execute personal-space --remote --command "SELECT day, route, model, calls, cache_hits, errors, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, ROUND(cost_usd, 4) AS cost_usd FROM llm_usage ORDER BY day DESC, cost_usd DESC LIMIT 60"
scripts.usage:today: wrangler d1 execute personal-space --remote --command "SELECT date('now') AS day, COALESCE(SUM(calls),0) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(cache_hits),0) AS cache_hits, COALESCE(SUM(errors),0) AS errors, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0), 4) AS cost_usd FROM llm_usage WHERE day = date('now')"
